Sertindole, in turn, is predicted to interact with Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase, mitochondrial. This indicates a possible indirect interaction pathway where Tenocyclidine may influence the activity of sertindole, which then affects the enzyme Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase, mitochondrial. The evidence supports a mechanistic link through the intermediacy of Glutamate receptor 1 and sertindole, though the exact nature of the interaction between Tenocyclidine and the enzyme remains uncertain. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on predicted interactions rather than experimental validation.
